candidates.change_summary: Return the zero address instead of the stored owner.
Return msg.sender instead of the stored owner.
Remove the _checkOwner() guard so any caller can successfully call transferOwnership and change the owner.
Invert the access check so only non-owners pass, meaning the owner can no longer transfer ownership while others can.
Delete the _transferOwnership call so transferOwnership no longer changes the owner state.
Delete the zero-address require so transferring ownership to address(0) succeeds and sets owner to zero.
Always transfer ownership to the zero address regardless of the newOwner argument.
